in_marathi.name: Sharanu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharanu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharanu is a Sanskrit name meaning 'protector' or 'refuge'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shara', which means 'protection'. The name Shanaru signifies the one who provides safety and security to others. It is a name that is deeply rooted in Hindu spirituality and is often given to girls who are believed to have strong protective qualities.
